result.summary:
Fixed the citation-attribution defect step-14b's gate identified. Read deps/ecto_sql/lib/ecto/adapters/sql/sandbox.ex lines 540-704 directly myself before editing (did not trust step-14b's line numbers either): confirmed `defp post_checkout(conn_mod, conn_state, opts)` is defined at lines 658-675 and `defp pre_checkin(:checkin, Connection, {conn_mod, conn_state, _in_transaction?}, opts)` (the ordinary-checkin clause) at lines 677-701, both in sandbox.ex -- exactly the range step-14b named, now confirmed first-hand rather than inherited. Also confirmed via the earlier gate's own grep claim (zero def/defp matches for post_checkout/pre_checkin anywhere under deps/db_connection) that manager.ex never defines either function; manager.ex only threads them as opaque keyword keys.

Edited lib/letflow/design/iss0113-tenant-fixture-sandbox-restore-opt-in.md at the two lines identified: 'deps/db_connection/lib/db_connection/ownership/manager.ex:658-675 (post_checkout)' -> 'deps/ecto_sql/lib/ecto/adapters/sql/sandbox.ex:658-675 (post_checkout)', and the same file-path swap for the :677-701 (pre_checkin) citation immediately below it. Nothing else in that paragraph or file changed: verified via `git diff` that the only content lines touched are the two file-path swaps, and confirmed by grep that the paragraph's other manager.ex citations (:241-242, :285-297, :364-386, :402-408, all part of the {:shared, pid} death-path trace that step-14b independently verified as accurate) are untouched, plus three unrelated manager.ex citations elsewhere in the doc (:224, :279, :220, describing ownership_checkout's :not_found auto-checkout path and its Map.put/case-clause reuse) are also untouched -- none of those name post_checkout/pre_checkin so none carried the defect.

Source of the original mis-citation: it is not new to rework #5 or this design doc. It originates in handoffs/WF03-ISS0480-20260905/step-13-issue-fixer-reassessment.json's own result.summary Item 1 (and its issues[0].description), which cites the same wrong manager.ex:658-701 range for post_checkout/pre_checkin. CODE-DESIGNER's rework #5 copied that citation verbatim into the design doc without independently re-verifying it against source, which is what let it through to this gate. That handoff is ISSUE-FIXER's own attestation of its diagnosis and is not mine to edit -- flagging it here per step-14b's next_action so ORCH has it on record: ORCH may want to file this as a MINOR finding via ISSUE_QUEUE.md against ISSUE-FIXER's step-13 handoff, per core-directives.md's 'Never resolve a conflict silently.' I did not file the issue myself since step-14b's next_action framed that as ORCH's call, not a blocking requirement on this rework.

No other section touched: §11.10.2a, §11.10.4a, and §11.10.5 item 4a are unchanged from rework #5, since step-14b confirmed checks 2-5 already PASS and unaffected by this correction. No implementation or test code added.
